page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX, AVX-512F, and AES-NI instruction sets. The server is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a generous 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Baseline networking throughput is rated at 5 Gbps. The configuration provides no bundled local instance storage and contains zero hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Benchmark results highlight balanced multithreaded capacity paired with conservative single-core speed. The instance registered a Geekbench single-core score of 928.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1,106.98, reflecting lower per-thread raw compute capacity. Conversely, concurrent multithreaded throughput reached 5,773.0 in Geekbench and 11,726.09 in stress-ng. Memory bandwidth benchmarks recorded 74.57 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 61.0 GB/sec for large-block writes. In real-world application benchmarks, the server achieved 11.54 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and sustained 7.45 GB/sec of static web serving throughput.

The 128 GB memory capacity delivers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound tasks where large datasets must be retained in RAM rather than relying on frequent storage round-trips. Because no local SSD storage is bundled, persistent I/O relies entirely on network-attached storage. The hardware profile is constrained for latency-sensitive single-threaded processing and generative LLM inference, where 7B models sustain only 8.48 tokens per second. Consequently, this server is best suited for in-memory data stores like Redis, relational database clusters using remote storage, batch ETL data pipelines, and enterprise middleware.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.4xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at 2.5 GHz. Allocated with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 128.0 GB of system memory, the instance delivers an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio suitable for memory-intensive enterprise tasks. The platform includes a 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, lacks local instance storage, and includes no GPU hardware. Synthetic benchmarks indicate modest single-thread capacity alongside solid multithreaded performance, demonstrated by 11.54 million Redis SET operations per second and stable large-block memory read speeds of 74.57 GB/sec. Given its high RAM capacity relative to CPU resources, this instance profile is best suited for in-memory caching layers such as Redis, relational and NoSQL database engines relying on network block storage, enterprise middleware, and batch ETL data pipelines.
